resources.string: Every sound tool. Nothing leaves your phone.
Any audio file, or the sound of a video
Open a sound or press Record. Everything you make stays on this phone.
It goes to Recently deleted for 30 days. The files you opened are not touched.
How Stave works, in the order a first day goes.

Pick a file, share one from another app, or press Record. MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, Opus, AIFF, the sound of a video — if the phone has it, Stave reads it. Your original is never changed: the app works on its own copy.

Drag over the waveform to select. Pinch to zoom, two fingers to scroll. The play-head is the fixed line in the middle; the sound moves under it. Every change can be undone, even after you close the app.
Clean up voice takes out hiss and room noise. Repair finds clicks, clipped peaks and mains hum and mends them. Open the spectrogram and paint over a cough to take it out of the sound around it.
Transcribe a recording and the words appear under the waveform. Tap words to select that stretch of audio; delete them and the audio goes with them. Take out every um and uh in one tap.
Add as many tracks as the phone can play. Record over them, draw automation on anything, send to buses, and bounce the mix. Takes are kept in lanes so nothing you record is lost.
Separate vocals, drums, bass and the rest on the phone, with no upload and no monthly count. Read the chords, slow a passage, loop it, mute the vocal and record your own over it.
Pick where the sound is going — podcast, streaming, broadcast — and Stave brings it to that loudness with a true-peak ceiling. Export to MP3, FLAC, WAV, Opus, AAC or ALAC with chapters and artwork.

Stave has no internet permission. The neural models that clean voices and separate songs run on the device. There is no account, no upload, no watermark, no limit, no subscription, and the source code is public.
Stuck on something? Contact is one tap away from the Home screen.
A person reads these. Nothing about your sound travels with a message unless you attach it yourself.
Questions, ideas, a format that would not open.

Stave has no internet permission, so it cannot send a recording anywhere. The models run on the device. You can check the permission on the Play listing.
No account, no cap, no watermark, no ad, no subscription. There is no server to pay for, so there is nothing to gate.
Stave is GPL-3.0. Every filter and every rule is in the repository and is executed by a test on every change.
From the makers of Squish, Still and Sheaf.
Soft motion behind the screens and in the icons. Off when the phone\'s animations are off.
A tap you can feel when a selection or a clip lands on a grid line or a cut.
32-bit float never clips in the file. 24-bit is what most tools expect.
Peak files and render caches. They are rebuilt when a project is opened.
Voice isolation, stem separation, speech and the tuner run on the device. The large models arrive with the app; a bigger speech model can be added from a file.
Written only to this phone. Share it if you want to send it.
